comment: p95 budgets in seconds for the jobs of ci.yml on main; scripts/ci_budget.py explains the rules. Set on 2026-11-21 from the p95 of the 15 successful runs since 2026-11-20 21:46 UTC plus about ten percent. Budgets only go down, except: on 2026-11-22 "windows installer" (230 -> 295) and "cli-only build (no GUI)" (155 -> 220) were re-baselined to the p95 of the 9 main runs since plus about ten percent, because test steps merged alongside the budgets (the Windows lab end-to-end check; the two Linux real-link checks) were missing from the measurement.
